name: Fresh Ink Booking
description: Appointment-only custom linework tattoo studio in Saint Paul, MN. AI agents can check availability, hold a slot, and hand the user a checkout link.

handoff.description: The agent books via hold_slot or POST /api/public/holds, then hands the returned checkout_url to the user's own agent or browser. The user locks the session in themselves; confirmation is observable via get_booking_status, webhooks, or the SSE stream.

api.authentication: Optional API key via POST /api/public/agent-keys; anonymous access works with lower rate limits. 429 responses carry Retry-After.
